_about: John Lightfoot (1602-1675), Hebraist and member of the Westminster Assembly: vol. 13 of his Whole Works, ed. J. R. Pitman (London, 1822-1825), which holds his Journal of the Proceedings of the Assembly of Divines, 1 January 1643 to 31 December 1644, with letters to and from him. Named john-lightfoot so J. B. Lightfoot's shelf (j-b-lightfoot) cannot be mistaken for it. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
